description: QUALIFY with ROW_NUMBER/RANK/DENSE_RANK, all comparison operators, partitions, WHERE/ORDER BY/LIMIT/TOP interaction, multiple window functions. Converted 1:1 from query/QualifyTest.java (now retired; the two at-least asserts pinned to the deterministic exact counts).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, department VARCHAR, salary INTEGER)

INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'Alice', 'Engineering', 100000), (2, 'Bob', 'Engineering', 95000), (3, 'Charlie', 'Engineering', 90000), (4, 'David', 'Sales', 85000), (5, 'Eve', 'Sales', 80000), (6, 'Frank', 'Sales', 75000), (7, 'Grace', 'HR', 70000), (8, 'Henry', 'HR', 65000)

SELECT id, name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) as rank
FROM employees
QUALIFY rank <= 3
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, department VARCHAR, salary INTEGER)

INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'Alice', 'Engineering', 100000), (2, 'Bob', 'Engineering', 95000), (3, 'Charlie', 'Engineering', 90000), (4, 'David', 'Sales', 85000), (5, 'Eve', 'Sales', 80000), (6, 'Frank', 'Sales', 75000), (7, 'Grace', 'HR', 70000), (8, 'Henry', 'HR', 65000)

SELECT id, name, department, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) as dept_rank
FROM employees
QUALIFY dept_rank <= 2
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, department VARCHAR, salary INTEGER)

INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'Alice', 'Engineering', 100000), (2, 'Bob', 'Engineering', 95000), (3, 'Charlie', 'Engineering', 90000), (4, 'David', 'Sales', 85000), (5, 'Eve', 'Sales', 80000), (6, 'Frank', 'Sales', 75000), (7, 'Grace', 'HR', 70000), (8, 'Henry', 'HR', 65000)

SELECT id, name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) as rank
FROM employees
QUALIFY rank <= 2
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, department VARCHAR, salary INTEGER)

INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'Alice', 'Engineering', 100000), (2, 'Bob', 'Engineering', 95000), (3, 'Charlie', 'Engineering', 90000), (4, 'David', 'Sales', 85000), (5, 'Eve', 'Sales', 80000), (6, 'Frank', 'Sales', 75000), (7, 'Grace', 'HR', 70000), (8, 'Henry', 'HR', 65000)
